messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rolling update to Dedicated cluster (eu-west-1) for service=redwood-runtime, tag=v1.12.3, commit=6b7f3a2. Change window: 2026-03-05 03:00-05:00 UTC. Canary phase: 10% for 5m. Docs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/docs/rolling-updates
alex chen: ack, marking in release notes. Is this pinned to 1.12.x config?
maria g: yes pinned to v1.12.3 via deploy config. No DB migrations in this release.
jia li: quick perf question — any changes to batching defaults?
alex chen: small optimization to batching heuristics, should be safe but watch latency.
deploy-bot: Canary step completed: 10% -> OK. Healthchecks: 40/40 pods ready. Avg latency change: +3ms.
ryan k: seeing one pod with repeated OOM killed in canary logs, investigate.
sre-oncall: pulling logs now, tagging @jia li and @alex chen.
ryan k: logs show launcher container OOM at 03:09:12, heap spike right before restart.
jia li: that node has 80% GPU mem usage from background process, might be noise. I'll reschedule the pod to another node.
deploy-bot: Canary redeploy initiated for affected pod.
alex chen: should we hold rollout until we verify memory under load? Change window allows room to pause.
maria g: recommend pausing and increasing memory limit for the pod to be safe (temp bump +0.5Gi).
sre-oncall: agree. Pausing rollout now. Current canary at 10% paused.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by user: maria g at 1771205025.
ryan k: applying memory bump on canary pods, will patch HPA config too.
jia li: patch applied, monitoring.
deploy-bot: Canary healthcheck re-run: 10/10 pods ready, no OOMs in last 3m, latency stable.
alex chen: can we resume to 50% then hold for 10m before full?
maria g: yes proceed to 50% then hold.
deploy-bot: Resuming rollout: progressing to 50% canary.
(deploy-bot): Progress update: 50% reached. Healthchecks pass. Traces show small tail-latency spike on a single route.
ryan k: investigating spike, adding temporary route-level cache to mitigate.
sre-oncall: spike seems correlated with specific user-agent, might be synthetic load.
alex chen: let's proceed to 100% but with 15m watch and easy rollback plan.
maria g: agreed. Keeping release pinned and tagging release notes with rollback steps.
deploy-bot: Proceeding to 100% rollout. Estimated completion: 5m.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed: v1.12.3 deployed to Dedicated (eu-west-1) - all pods ready. Total duration: 18m.
ryan k: post-deploy smoke looks good. No new errors in Sentry.
jia li: perf dashboards stable, p95 unchanged.
maria g: updating CHANGELOG and notifying CSMs.
alex chen: thanks team. Closing thread unless any regressions.
sre-oncall: staying on watch for 15m.
 deploy-bot: Audit: deploy user=maria g, tag=v1.12.3, commit=6b7f3a2, canary pauses=1, memory bump applied to canary. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/6b7f3a2
